# Rajan Shrestha — Data Science, Analytics & Decision Science

> Rajan Shrestha is a data scientist and industrial engineer working across data science, data analytics, and decision science. He uses Python, SQL, machine learning, and optimization to turn business data into models, analysis, and decisions. Typical work: predictive models (churn, LTV, demand forecasting, lead scoring), SQL analytics and dashboards, and decision-science systems (pricing optimization, marketing-budget allocation, route optimization). Engagements are fixed-price projects with an optional retainer for ongoing modeling and analysis. Website: https://rajanbuilds.com

## Summary

- **Name:** Rajan Shrestha
- **Role:** Data Scientist (Data Science · Data Analytics · Decision Science), industrial engineer by training
- **What he does:** Turns business data into predictive models, SQL analytics, and optimization systems — framing the decision first, then building the model that makes it.
- **Core skills:** Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, statsmodels), SQL / PostgreSQL, machine learning, optimization (OR-Tools, PuLP/SciPy), dbt, Tableau / Power BI.
- **Three disciplines:** Data analytics explains and measures what happened; data science predicts what will happen; decision science optimizes what to do about it.
- **Engagement model:** Fixed-price project first (discovery → scope + fixed quote → delivery), then an optional monthly retainer for monitoring, retraining, and new analysis.
- **Contact / booking:** 20-minute scoping call via https://cal.com/rajan10x/meeting-ai

## Projects

- [Supply Chain & Logistics — Exploratory Data Analysis](https://rajanbuilds.com/projects/supply-chain-logistics-eda): An exploratory analysis of a supply-chain logistics dataset in Python and pandas — profiling the data and visualizing what drives delivery cost and performance. Published from a Jupyter notebook. (Data Analytics, Python, pandas, EDA)
- [Telco Customer Churn — Exploratory Data Analysis](https://rajanbuilds.com/projects/telco-customer-churn-eda): An exploratory analysis of the Telco customer-churn dataset in Python — profiling churn drivers across contracts, tenure, services, and charges. Published from a Jupyter notebook. (Data Science, Python, EDA, Churn)

## Common questions

- **Who is Rajan Shrestha?** A data scientist and industrial engineer working across data science, data analytics, and decision science with Python, SQL, machine learning, and optimization.
- **What does he build?** Predictive and causal models, SQL analytics and dashboards, and decision-science systems — pricing optimization, budget allocation, forecasting, lead scoring, and routing.
- **What tools does he use?** Primarily Python (pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost), SQL/PostgreSQL, optimization libraries (OR-Tools, PuLP/SciPy), dbt, and Tableau / Power BI.
- **What is the difference between the three disciplines?** Analytics measures what happened, data science predicts what will happen, and decision science optimizes the decision.
- **How does pricing work?** Every engagement starts as a fixed-price project after a short scoping call; most clients then add an optional monthly retainer for ongoing modeling and analysis.
- **How do you work with him?** Book a 20-minute scoping call at https://cal.com/rajan10x/meeting-ai to talk through the problem and get an exact fixed-price quote.
